strategies.name: Sequential all-reduce with interleaved scaling
strategies.desc: Performs 8 sequential all-reduce operations with local element-wise scaling/unscaling between each stage, exactly as in the reference. Each iteration applies per-shard scaling, all-reduces, then unscales. Total 8 all-reduce dispatches with full vector (W*S) payload each time. Trades dispatch count for simplicity and correctness.

strategies.name: Fused scaling with vectorized operations
strategies.desc: Pre-computes all scaling coefficients as tensors and uses broadcasting/indexing to eliminate per-shard loops, replacing them with single vectorized operations. Still performs 8 all-reduce dispatches but reduces local compute overhead by fusing W element-wise operations into batched tensor ops. Same collective count but better local compute efficiency.

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter followed by all-gather chain
strategies.desc: Decomposes each all-reduce into reduce-scatter + all-gather pairs, allowing each rank to compute only its output shard during the reduce-scatter phase, then broadcast via all-gather. Total 16 collective dispatches (2 per stage) but with smaller per-dispatch payloads (S instead of W*S for reduce-scatter phases). Trades more dispatches for reduced bandwidth per operation.

strategies.name: Pipelined two-stage batched reduction
strategies.desc: Groups the 8 stages into pairs or batches, overlapping the all-reduce communication of stage i+1 with local compute of stage i by preparing multiple buffers. Requires careful buffer management and async dispatch if supported. Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but attempts to hide local compute latency within communication time through pipelining.

strategies.name: Single all-reduce with compound scaling
strategies.desc:
Mathematically restructures the 8 dependent stages by pre-computing the compound effect of all scale/unscale operations, then performs a single all-reduce on an appropriately pre-scaled input. Requires analyzing the mathematical composition of operations to identify cancellations and merged coefficients. Reduces to 1 or 2 all-reduce dispatches by trading upfront analytical complexity for minimal collective operations.
